description: Suno Studio effect. Band-limits with a highpass and lowpass, applies a lo-fi tilt EQ, and blends in a fixed-depth amplitude quantizer for gritty texture and FX layers. Apply to the rendered FX / OTHER stem inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Band-limits with a highpass and lowpass, applies a lo-fi tilt EQ, and blends in a fixed-depth amplitude quantizer for gritty texture and FX layers.

hp.description: Highpass corner that removes low weight for a thin, textural layer.
hp.label: HP

lp.description: Lowpass corner that rolls off the top for lo-fi darkness.
lp.label: LP

lofi tilt.description: Single tilt control: boosts lows near 250Hz and cuts highs near 5kHz (or the reverse when negative).
lofi tilt.label: Lo-Fi

degrade.description: Amount of the fixed 8-level amplitude quantizer (copied from digital-degrade) blended in for grit.
degrade.label: Degrade

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
